matrix_name.name: Polyvinyl chloride
matrix_name.description: PVC powder (density 1.37; K value 71; melting 80 °C; Tg 87 °C).

fillers.name: Graphite
fillers.description: Graphite nanosheets (foliated graphite, prepared via acid intercalation/exfoliation + sonication); thickness 30–50 nm (~40 nm avg); high aspect ratio; contains surface functional groups formed during exfoliation (e.g., C–O–C, C–OH, –COOH). Mixed with Cu nanoparticles at 90/10 wt% within the filler blend.

fillers.name: Copper
fillers.description: Copper nanoparticles prepared by ball milling; average particle size ~20 nm. Present as 10 wt% of the graphite/Cu filler blend.
